description: Implementation of the User Plane message decoder for Open Fronthaul, including header parsing, section decoding, IQ data decompression, and utility functions for message inspection.

classes.name: uplane_message_decoder_impl
classes.description: Class implementing the decoding of User Plane messages, including header and section parsing, and IQ data handling.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Decodes a User Plane message into results, parsing header and all sections.

methods.name: decode_header
methods.description: Parses the header of the message to extract parameters.

methods.name: decode_all_sections
methods.description: Decodes all sections within the message.

methods.name: decode_section
methods.description: Decodes a single section, including header, compression info, and IQ data.

methods.name: decode_compression_length
methods.description: Parses the compression length if applicable.

methods.name: decode_iq_data
methods.description: Decompresses IQ samples from the message.
